lyrics.text: From the first beat to the last
Through the cold and through the fast
Through the fever, through the night
You kept every rhythm right
This is the symphony of the heart
Beating on, a work of art
Faster, slower, strong and true
Every beat belongs to you
A hundred thousand beats a day
Never stopping on the way
Pumping life to every part
Here's to you, the beating heart
This is the symphony of the heart
Beating on, a work of art
Faster, slower, strong and true
Every beat belongs to you
Lub dub, lub dub, hear it sing
Life is in the beat we bring
This is the symphony of the heart
Beating on, a work of art
Faster, slower, strong and true
Every beat belongs to you
